author: Unity
description:
Discover how Icon Group is using Unity’s technology to bridge hardware and software to create the next generation of human machine interfaces (HMIs). Find out how digital interaction meets physical for cars, intelligent toys, home appliances, and beyond.

Dr. Steffen P. Walz, Group Managing Director, icon group GmbH
title: Icon Group: Real-time 3D engines to rule them all  | Unite 2024
